subject.title: Feature: per-channel announce suppression for sub-agents

question: What public completion-delivery contract should own suppression: a generic agent-level audience policy with optional per-spawn and channel matching, or separate channel-specific settings?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but configuration ownership and granularity affect compatibility, channel boundaries, fallback semantics, and overlap with the open parent-routing and extension-hook requests.

options.title: Unified audience policy
options.body: Define one generic sub-agent completion policy under the agent/runtime boundary, default it to current external delivery, and allow narrowly scoped per-spawn or channel matching.

options.title: Global and per-spawn only
options.body: Keep channel adapters free of completion policy and support only a global default plus explicit spawn overrides.

options.title: Channel-specific settings
options.body: Add independent channel configuration keys, accepting duplicated policy and greater configuration-surface growth.

recommendation.title: Unified audience policy
recommendation.body: Define one generic sub-agent completion policy under the agent/runtime boundary, default it to current external delivery, and allow narrowly scoped per-spawn or channel matching.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-introduction history and recent review make this the strongest available routing candidate for the public API and compatibility choice.
